contract.export_cache: thread-local, read-only, bounded to each thread's most recent export; key: repository, resolved commit, path set, digest of export arguments + git version + git config --list, attribute sources by content (info/attributes, GIT_ATTR_GLOBAL, GIT_ATTR_SYSTEM, every .gitattributes blob of the exported tree via ls-tree -z + cat-file --batch), attr.tree/GIT_ATTR_SOURCE by resolved tree, replace refs and switches, repository/object-store redirection; never reused when export-subst is in effect, when a filter smudge/process driver meets a filter= attribute, or when any input cannot be established; failed exports never cached
contract.measurement_reuse: opt-in by test helpers only; key: exact child payload, depth, platform/interpreter, environment minus PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST, verified installed dependency content (spec + entry floor); a hit is a deep copy naming the earlier test, executes nothing, mints no context, and is refused if the earlier binding's dependency files differ from installed content; failures never stored; thread-local, session-scoped
